text: DEFONEOS — DfE Schools AI Safeguarding Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Article 50 DEFONEOS × DfE × SCHOOLS SAFEGUARDING DfE Schools AI Safeguarding Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK schools safeguarding — multi-agency risk assessment, attendance analytics, child exploitation detection, online safety monitoring, SEND safeguarding, and school improvement governance. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 5 Backbone Orgs 🏛️ 12 Entry Points LADO Local Authority Designated Officer (LADO) Case Management Allegations against adults working with children. Multi-agency strategy discussion coordination. DBS referral tracking. Threshold decision support. Case lifecycle management from allegation through investigation to resolution. 12,000+ LADO referrals processed annually across 153 local authorities. MASH Multi-Agency Safeguarding Hub (MASH) Intelligence Information sharing across police, health, education, and social care. Risk threshold assessment. Early help escalation pathway. Chronology compilation from multi-source records. 500,000+ referrals processed annually through 80+ MASH operations in England. Attendance School Attendance & Persistent Absence Analytics Real-time attendance monitoring across 22,000+ state schools. Persistent absence early warning. Missing in Education tracking. Elective home education monitoring. Part-time timetable governance. 8.9M+ pupils tracked. 22.3% persistent absence rate (2023-24) requiring intervention. CSE/CCE Child Sexual & Criminal Exploitation Detection County lines pattern recognition. Online grooming detection. Child exploitation warning indicators. Trafficking risk assessment. NRM referral intelligence. 17,000+ potential CSE cases identified annually. CCE indicators tracked across education, health, and police data. Online Safety Online Safety in Schools Monitoring KCSIE-compliant filtering and monitoring system oversight. Harmful content detection. Peer-on-peer online abuse indicators. Radicalisation online risk (Prevent duty). Cyberbullying pattern detection. 22,000+ schools' filtering compliance monitored under Ofsted framework. SEND SEND Safeguarding & EHCP Governance Education, Health and Care Plan safeguarding integration. SEND tribunal case management. Annual review compliance monitoring. Placement suitability assessment. Therapeutic provision oversight. 576,000+ EHCPs in England (2024). 31.6% year-on-year growth in EHC plans requiring governance. Governance School Governance & MAT Oversight Multi-academy trust safeguarding audit. Board safeguarding training compliance. Single central record verification. Governor DBS checking. 24,000+ governing boards across England. 1,800+ academy trusts. Safeguarding leadership effectiveness monitoring. Early Help Early Help & Family Support Assessment Early Help Assessment (EHA) pathway management. Family support plan tracking. CAF legacy system migration. Early intervention tier threshold support. Children in Need prevention analytics. 350,000+ children supported via early help annually. Prevent Prevent Duty & Channel Referral Intelligence Radicalisation risk assessment in education settings. Channel programme referral analytics. ERG 22+ indicator monitoring. British values curriculum compliance. 6,000+ Channel referrals annually from education sector. Ideology-neutral threat assessment framework. Inspection Ofsted Safeguarding Inspection Intelligence Pre-inspection safeguarding evidence compilation. Section 175/157 compliance monitoring. Safeguarding audit trail automation. Post-inspection action plan tracking. Safeguarding concerns escalation pathway. 5,000+ Section 8 and full inspections annually. Data DfE Children's Data & Analytics Hub National Pupil Database integration. Children in Need census processing. Schools census safeguarding flag analytics. CIN/CLA/PPU data linkage.
